results.ask: What's special about my block? I'm on 46th Ave between Moraga and Noriega.
results.expect: calls about_block; gives the block's own figures and something pinned nearby, with sources; cites
results.answer:
Your block sits about 39 feet above sea level, just 0.2 miles from Ocean Beach. Most homes here were built around 1941, though the oldest dates back to 1908 (SF Assessor-Recorder).

A few things nearby:
* **Patriotic Homes**: Two blocks east, builders gave model homes hopeful names during WWII, like the "Rainbow House" (1941) and "Freedom House" (1942) [Doelger Architecture](https://www.outsidelands.org/doelger-types.php).
* **Shipwrecks**: About 0.3 miles southwest, the hull of the clipper ship *King Philip* (wrecked 1878) is buried under the sand; its ribs occasionally surface after winter storms [NPS](https://home.nps.gov/goga/learn/historyculture/vestiges-shipwrecks.htm).
* **Old Photos**: The [OpenSFHistory](https://opensfhistory.org) archive has photographs pinned right at your corner of 46th and Moraga.

Like every block here, yours is built on a deep layer of dune sand [USGS](https://pubs.usgs.gov/wri/1993/1993.pdf).

Do you know any other stories about your block? I can add them to the notes for the next neighbor.
